notes: Rear-panel SDI In, SDI Loop Out, and SDI Monitor Out all share the device's stated "SDI Rates: 1.5G, 3G, 6G, 12G" spec, so all three are graded sdi-12g; note the SDI/HDMI Monitor Out signal itself is capped at 1080p50/59.94/60 (downconverted for monitoring) even though the SDI connector supports up to 12G. HDMI Monitor Out has no HDMI version (1.4/2.0/2.1) stated in the spec sheet, so grade omitted. The rear USB-C (labeled "WEBCAM OUT"/"LIVE STREAM" in the panel diagram) outputs webcam video up to 2160p60 but no USB generation/speed is specified, so grade omitted; it is functionally an output-only webcam/streaming port even though USB-C is normally bidirectional, direction set to output per its documented function. Front-panel USB-C is a control/device-control port (front panel, USB-C, or Ethernet for control), set bidirectional as a host-type USB-C connection with no stated speed grade. Power is dual-redundant: internal 100-240V AC via IEC inlet, plus a 4-pin XLR +12V DC input. Source PDF used is a reseller-hosted mirror (ggvideo.com) of Blackmagic Design's official product tech-spec PDF (copyright Blackmagic Design Pty. Ltd.); content is verbatim manufacturer spec including the official rear/front panel port diagram, so treated as authoritative. The current live blackmagicdesign.com techspecs page no longer lists the Web Presenter 4K (superseded in Blackmagic's lineup by Streaming Encoder/Decoder 4K), so the archived manufacturer PDF was used instead.
